newsitem.title: UK: Henlys to sell motor unit for 56.6 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Henlys to sell motor unit for 56.6 mln stg.

text.p: British vehicle distributor and public service vehicle manufacturer Henlys Group Plc said on Tuesday it was selling its motor division for an estimated 56.6 million stg.

It said the buyer of the division, which excludes two dealerships and some properties, was HMG Holdings Ltd and HMG Thames Ltd, which are incorporated by Legal and General Ventures Ltd and Dennis Stickley.
Henlys said the sale would enable it to focus on its coach and bus division and anticipated a net cash surplus of 28 million stg following the sale.
The motor division comprises 32 motor dealerships holding franchises for most of the major vehicle manufacturers, said the company.
By 0707 GMT, shares in Henlys had climbed 19p to stand at 435p on the news.
